notes: 0.3.49：还原备份不再有死路。备份根 ~\.dsh\backups 混着三类东西，面板现在按内容分类、每类都给还原入口：①配置快照（config-*/manual-*）= 时点回退，原样保留；②插件备份（plugin-<版本>-*）= 回滚插件，先把当前插件整份备份成 plugin-<当前版本>-<时间戳>，再写回插件安装目录；③会话备份（session-corrupt-*）= 把 --<路径编码>-- 会话目录写回 ~\.dsh\sessions，同名目录先整份留底到 backups\session-<时间戳>；④认不出类型的（冲突对照、手工拷来的）弹「手动还原」指引：备份路径 + 里面有什么 + 三类常见目标位置，不再有「不可还原」的死按钮。顺带修两个实测出来的坑：一是目录合并复制——Copy-Item -Recurse 遇到已存在的同名目录会把源目录整个塞进去，实测回滚后 runtime\sync.ps1 根本没被覆盖（现在用 Copy-Tree 逐层合并）；二是分类判据——profile 的 package.json 里也有 dsh 字段（dsh.profile.bundles），按 dsh 判插件会把 8 份 config-* 和 2 份 manual-* 全误判成插件备份，现在按 name: dsh-profile-* / dsh.profile 判配置、name: dsh-config-sync 判插件，再按顶层内容与目录名前缀兜底。空目录（半截安装残留）标「空备份」，不给按钮。隔离环境实测：插件回滚的三个顶层条目（含嵌套 runtime\sync.ps1）全部被覆盖、当前插件整份留底；会话还原写回成功且当前状态留底。
notesEn: 0.3.49: restoring a backup is never a dead end any more. ~\.dsh\backups holds three different kinds of backups, and the panel now classifies each by content and gives every kind a working entry: (1) config snapshots (config-*/manual-*) = point-in-time rollback, unchanged; (2) plugin backups (plugin-<version>-*) = roll back the plugin, copying the current plugin to plugin-<current version>-<timestamp> first, then writing it back into the plugin folder; (3) session backups (session-corrupt-*) = write the --<path-encoded>-- session folders back into ~\.dsh\sessions, copying any existing folder of the same name to backups\session-<timestamp> first; (4) anything unrecognised (conflict comparisons, hand-copied folders) opens a manual restore hint — backup path, what is inside, and the three usual targets — instead of a greyed-out "cannot restore". Two bugs found while testing are also fixed: merging copies (Copy-Item -Recurse drops a whole source directory inside an existing same-named one, so runtime\sync.ps1 was never actually overwritten after a rollback; Copy-Tree now merges level by level), and the classification test (a profile package.json also carries a dsh field — dsh.profile.bundles — so judging plugins by dsh misclassified all 8 config-* and 2 manual-* snapshots; it now keys off name: dsh-profile-* / dsh.profile for config, name: dsh-config-sync for plugins, then top-level contents and the folder-name prefix). Empty folders (half-finished installs) are marked "empty backup" with no button. Measured in an isolated folder: all three top-level entries of a plugin rollback (including the nested runtime\sync.ps1) were overwritten while the current plugin was copied aside, and the session restore wrote back while keeping the previous state.
